reason: 该插件的核心用户价值是“会话通知中心”：基于 DSH 事件源为人工干预场景提供提醒，并将提醒以系统通知或应用内 toast 方式展示，结合设置项控制是否、何时、何类通知触达。证据（README 与 package.json）显示其为 DSH 的 Host/Client 插件、监听事件并按分类过滤、并支持点击跳转到相关会话，因此归为通知与监控类插件。

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DSH 会话的通知中心插件，可将审批、提问确认、目标阻塞、任务完成和错误等事件按配置推送为系统通知或应用内 toast，并支持点击跳转到对应会话。
summaries.en: This is a DSH session notification plugin that surfaces configured events such as approvals, question prompts, blocked goals, task completion, and errors as system notifications or in-app toasts, with one-click navigation to the related session.

capabilities: Monitors DSH event streams for configured agent/workflow/session events
Displays user-facing notifications via browser Notification API and in-app toasts
Supports per-category notification level configuration and focus/session filtering
Provides session jump actions from notifications
Exposes a settings/configuration surface for notification behavior

reasons.code: README documents host/client split and explicit event categories (approval/request, ask_user_question, goal/changed, agent/inbox, task/error/start events) routed through filtering and queueing.
README documents dual notification channels: browser Notification API and app toast stack, with click actions that focus window and open sessions.
README describes user settings for total switch, per-category levels (off/app/system), focus suppression, and test notification behavior.
Package metadata identifies this as a DSH plugin bundle with web client and host/client exports, indicating runtime integration inside the DSH platform.
